The reference lane is represented by Constellation as the obvious nuclear baseload/data-center PPA anchor. The underfollowed lane emphasizes Talen as a nuclear/data-center power asset owner, Centrus as a domestic HALEU and uranium-enrichment bottleneck candidate, and Bowman Consulting as a small-cap engineering services name exposed to bridge power, utility interconnection, and data-center power-generation execution. No investment recommendation is implied. Layer 1B expands the underfollowed universe around AI data-center power bottlenecks. The strongest chokepoint lens is not generic utility exposure, but scarce domestic nuclear fuel inputs, advanced-reactor project execution risk, and electrical transmission/interconnection contractors needed to turn signed data-center power demand into usable capacity. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the universe around AI data-center power constraints with a deliberate underfollowed lane. The strongest small/mid-cap discovery candidates found in this pass are not hyperscalers or large utilities; they sit in temporary/on-site generation, utility/data-center engineering, electrical construction, and nuclear fuel. The common chokepoint is not just electricity supply, but the ability to secure firm megawatts, interconnect facilities, build substations/transmission, and eventually fuel advanced nuclear capacity.
